dimensions.name: Requirement Traceability
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every requirement cites which prior artifact it comes from — a specific line, quote, question, or named open/blocker item in the Press Release, External FAQ, or Internal FAQ. A reader can point to the source sentence for any requirement in the document.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more requirements appear with no source reference, or the source reference is vague ('per the FAQ') rather than pointing at a specific question or line. A requirement invented independently of the validated PR/FAQ package fails this dimension even if it is otherwise well-written.

dimensions.name: Testable Acceptance Criteria
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every functional requirement has at least one acceptance criterion written as observable given/when/then behavior — specific enough that an engineer could write a test against it without asking a follow-up question.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Acceptance criteria are vague ('works correctly', 'handles errors gracefully'), subjective ('feels fast'), or missing entirely for a requirement. A criterion that cannot be turned into a pass/fail test fails this dimension.

dimensions.name: Edge Case Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: Each requirement names at least one failure mode, boundary condition, or recovery path beyond the happy path — what happens when an input is missing, a dependency fails, or two conditions conflict.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A requirement describes only the happy path with no edge cases considered, or edge cases are named without any indication of expected behavior.

dimensions.name: Non-Functional Requirements
dimensions.pass_criteria: Performance, security/privacy, reliability/recovery, accessibility, observability/telemetry, and scale/cost are each addressed with a real answer or explicitly marked open with a named owner — not silently skipped.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more non-functional categories are missing from the document entirely, with no open-item marker explaining the omission.

dimensions.name: Open Item Propagation
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every [OPEN] and [BLOCKER] item from the Press Release, External FAQ, and Internal FAQ that was not resolved before this stage still appears in the Requirements document with its owner intact, or is explicitly noted as resolved with how and when.
dimensions.fail_criteria: An open item or blocker from a prior stage disappears without explanation, is softened into a passing mention, or is worked around silently instead of being carried forward or marked resolved.
